input: 帮我写一份本月经营分析报告
expected_sql: SELECT 品类, SUM(金额) AS 销售额, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM orders JOIN products ON orders.product_id = products.id WHERE orders.status = '已完成' AND strftime('%Y-%m', 下单时间) = strftime('%Y-%m', 'now') GROUP BY 品类 ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
expected_output: 包含 Summary + 关键发现 + 行动建议的完整报告
notes: 典型报告需求，走全流程

input: 本季度销售业绩综合报告
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', 下单时间) AS 月份, SUM(金额) AS 销售额 FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' GROUP BY 月份 ORDER BY 月份
expected_output: 季度趋势图 + 销售额分析 + 经营建议

input: 做一份完整的用户行为分析报告
expected_sql: SELECT users.城市, COUNT(DISTINCT orders.user_id) AS 购买用户数, AVG(reviews.评分) AS 平均评分 FROM orders JOIN users ON orders.user_id = users.id LEFT JOIN reviews ON orders.product_id = reviews.product_id WHERE orders.status = '已完成' GROUP BY users.城市
expected_output: 用户画像 + 行为特征 + 优化建议
notes: '完整'关键词触发 report 而非 analysis

input: 分析一下最近的经营情况，给我一个全面的洞察
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 总订单, SUM(金额) AS 总销售额, AVG(金额) AS 平均客单价 FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成'
expected_output: 多维度数据 + 业务洞察 + 改进方向
notes: '全面' + '洞察' 双关键词触发 report

input: 各品类销售业绩报告，要有图表和分析
expected_sql: SELECT 品类, SUM(金额) AS 销售额, COUNT(*) AS 订单数, AVG(金额) AS 平均客单价 FROM orders JOIN products ON orders.product_id = products.id WHERE orders.status = '已完成' GROUP BY 品类
expected_output: 柱状图 + 指标分析 + 完整报告
notes: 用户明确同时要求图表和分析 → 归类为 report
